description: Meta keeps its container images under Renovate: the release build container and the Bazel platform images, pinned by digest like Core's.

customManagers.description: Container images pinned by digest where no built-in manager reads them: the release workflow's build container expression and the Bazel execution platforms.

packageRules.description: The build container builds every Linux release binary and the platform images run remote builds: a new digest is proposed a week after its release, in a group of its own, and never automerged.
